Harry Brook Hits Fastest Double Century, Surpassing Shubman Gill's Record

England cricketer Harry Brook has set a new record for the fastest double century in One Day Internationals (ODIs), surpassing Shubman Gill's previous record which lasted less than a month. Brook achieved this feat during a match where a total of 859 runs were scored, with Sri Lanka also making history in the same game. The Lallantop reported that Brook's record-breaking double century surpassed Gill's, while News18 Hindi noted the high-scoring nature of the match with 859 runs and Sri Lanka's historic performance, suggesting Brook's achievement overshadowed Sri Lanka's own historic feat.
